# dedalus_machine_port (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dedalus_machine_port" "example_machine_port" {
  machine_id = "017f22e2-79b0-7cc3-98c4-dc0c0c07398f"
  port = 8080
  protocol = "http"
  visibility = "private"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `machine_id` (String) Bare, lowercase, hyphenated Machine UUID. Pass the returned machine_id unchanged.
- `port` (Number)

### Optional

- `expires` (Number) Port lifetime in integer seconds. Omit for no expiry.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Required when visibility is key_required. Choose exactly 8 ASCII letters or digits. Forbidden for private and public ports. No access key is generated.
- `protocol` (String) Available values: "http".
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `visibility` (String) Who may reach the port. private requires an owning-organization API key. key_required requires an owner-chosen password at creation. public accepts anonymous requests, which can wake the machine and incur compute charges.
Available values: "public", "key_required", "private".

### Read-Only

- `application_url` (String) Isolated guest application origin. Direct clients preserve their HTTP method and body and send any required Dedalus credential in headers.
- `created_at` (String)
- `error_code` (String)
- `error_message` (String)
- `expires_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `port_id` (String)
- `ready_at` (String)
- `retry_after_ms` (Number)
- `status` (String) Unavailable is a recoverable failure reaching the guest service. See error_code and error_message for the diagnosis.
Available values: "wake_in_progress", "ready", "unavailable", "closed", "expired", "failed".
- `url` (String) Stable browser share URL. Browser navigation only; use application_url for APIs, webhooks, and WebSockets.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) The timeout for the operation, default: 300 seconds
- `delete` (String) The timeout for the operation, default: 300 seconds
- `read` (String) The timeout for the operation, default: 120 seconds
- `update` (String) The timeout for the operation, default: 120 seconds

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import dedalus_machine_port.example '<machine_id>/<port_id>'
```
